{{Quote|Subject identified as Duchess Satine Kryze.|A police probe|<ref name="TCWDofM" />}}
The '''police probe''' was a type of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|hovering]] [[Cam droid/Legends|cam]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] used by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] to assist in [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|policing]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Unidentified police probe/Legends|One probe]] was present after [[Davu Golec/Legends|Davu Golec]] of the [[Republic Ministry of Intelligence/Legends|Republic Ministry of Intelligence]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an [[Unidentified Death Watch assassin/Legends|assassin]]. Seeing only [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] at the scene, the probe assumed that she had been the murderer. After informing other CSF forces of the situation, the probe initiated a police chase, though the Duchess eventually escaped the area.

==Description==
The [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force's]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] [[Probe droid/Legends|probe]]<ref name="TCWDofM" /> was a specialized model of [[Cam droid/Legends|cam droid]] used to search for suspected criminals in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|lower levels]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Episode Guide" /> Painted in a [[Color/Legends|blue]]-gray paint scheme, it had an overall ellipsoid body of two bowl-shaped halves joined together with a recessed trench in the middle. On top were lights housed in truncated, conical projections, one of which was blue and the other red. On the front were two [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]] that projected from conical housings, as did a camera. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] had a siren, an antenna, was able to make transmissions, and was also able to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] in a [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] voice.<ref name="TCWDofM" />

==History==
On Coruscant,<ref name="TCWDofM" /> around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SWAnnual2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> during a secret meeting between [[Davu Golec/Legends|Davu Golec]] of the [[Republic Ministry of Intelligence/Legends|Republic Ministry of Intelligence]] and [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], an [[Unidentified Death Watch assassin/Legends|assassin]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] terrorist group [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] Golec with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. [[Unidentified police probe/Legends|A probe]] heard the shot and responded to the scene. Seeing only Duchess Kryze, the probe assumed she had killed Golec. The Duchess fled the scene, and the probe, after informing nearby security forces of the situation, followed after her with CSF [[GU-series Guardian police droid/Legends|police droids]] and [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]] joining the chase. The Duchess disabled the probe with a [[Deactivator hold-out pistol/Legends|deactivator pistol]] and was able to get away. Later, she surrendered to the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]], and her name was cleared.<ref name="TCWDofM" />

Another probe was present in Coruscant's [[Lower market districts/Legends|lower market districts]] when the droids [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] went there to buy [[Jogan fruit/Legends|jogan fruits]] for a cake in honor of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Aang/Legends|Aang]].<ref name="TCWEP">{{TCW|Evil Plans}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The police probe was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' TV series and was voiced by [[Tom Kane]]. It first appeared in the fourteenth episode of [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|Season Two]], "[[Duchess of Mandalore]]," which aired on [[February 12]], [[2010]].<ref name="DofMEG">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/duchess-of-mandalore-episode-guide|text="Duchess of Mandalore" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> It also had brief appearances on the eighth episode of [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|Season Three]], "[[Evil Plans]],"<ref name="TCWEP" /> which aired on [[November 5]], 2010,<ref name="Evil Plans Ep Guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/evil-plans-episode-guide|text="Evil Plans" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> and on the seventeenth episode of [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|Season Five]], "[[Sabotage (episode)|Sabotage]],"<ref name="TCWSabotage">{{TCW|Sabotage (episode)}}</ref> which aired on [[February 9]], [[2013]].<ref name="Explore: Sabotage">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/sabotage-episode-guide|text="Sabotage" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref>
